title: Minimum Moves to Equal Array Elements
goal: Solve Minimum Moves to Equal Array Elements: View incrementing all but one element as decreasing that one relative to the others, reducing the target to the minimum value.
strategy: View incrementing all but one element as decreasing that one relative to the others, reducing the target to the minimum value.
edgeCases: Equal arrays need zero moves; the total counts distances from the minimum, not the average.
